content: Jisas king kin pugri Jerusalem nar no
Muq ni Jerusalem tumo mondo di ni tiqe Betpage Betani ane tende mondo. Ni nyumo oliv yemu kin rand tende qunambe yemu di Jisas nikin wute temi yeri nindim pre tiqi nundom mo.

Ni yeri nindim nari, “Nungoqi tequ tiqe tumo te yequ kin tende wo. Nungoqi tiqe te ningg warne wondo di donki ghair iri wuq muang pu yenu wuqoind ye. Wuti iri ni donki te ningg no segine. Donki te sare bure wundig di wutanyi ven wandi.

Di wuti iri nungoqi pengu nunduq nari, ‘Pughe kin ningg nungoqi puq wen?’ tedi nungoqi oyi wuti te simbe wundig wari, ‘Yumbui ni yembe rise bu pitanyi po pre di brequne mune pitanyi badi ye’.” Ni pugri yeri nindim pre muq tiqi nundom mo.
Muq ni temi mo donki te ngimrawu ne sare pe mibo pre dabo opu mi neyi ni pu yenu muqoind. Di ni temi mondo sare bure mindig mindig yemu
di wute ninge ninde tumone yemu kin ni mari, “Pughe kin ningg nungoqi donki te sare bure wundig?”
Di ni Jisas yeri nindim kin pugrine simbe mand, di ni rar muqond mo.
Ni donki te mitanyi mo Jisas nde di ni nikin chongo dobui te donki wam mawo, di Jisas newo nas.
Wute nganye buagi nikin chongo dobui ngimne ruwo ruwo rire ruso di ninge nyumo muange wuny mbe pu gure ruwo rire rindi kin te ngimne ruwo rise.
Wute ninge ye ruwo, ninge Jisas nde dobu ruwi, di quan buagine pugri riri,

content.text: God nu wuti Yumbui nde nyamb pe nandi kin nen yuwon wang. [Sng 118:25-26]
God, nu beghi koku Devit ni yumbo buagi ninde si nambu rise kin te muq mune rindi kin te yuwon wany. Yumbui wam nganye nas kin ni nyamb wundivi viyo.”

content: Jisas ni Jerusalem nar no di tene no God ningg baj pe, di ni yumbo buagi tende yeru kin te nuqond nuqond no. Pudi burpoq rip pre pugri bu ni nikin wute 12-pela pu te ane mune Betani mo.
Jisas ni nyumo fig ningg nari ni yi namb segi
Yambgriq ni Betani si miraq mo di Jisas ni mir gureg.

Ni wonjine rar neq wuso, nyumo fig iri raqe ane yenu nuqoind, di ni no nuqoind, yi neyi pu bri. Ni nondo tumo nuqond di fig yi segi, raqene rise, te pugri tende puayi fig ni yi meyi kin ngeri te segine.
Muq Jisas ni nyumo fig te ningg nari, “Nu muq wute nu ningg yi te mune me segi ye.” Di ni wand ven puq nand kin te Jisas nikin wute ni mutungu mutungu ne puq nand.
Jisas wute God ningg baj pe maket muaq kin te bub nare mo

Ni mo Jerusalem mitari righe, di Jisas ni God ningg baj imb wabe nar no, di wute God ningg baj pe yumbo wong mand di maket muaq kin te bub nare mo. Wute ninge mas wet bidi kantri aye kin materi di ni mingg wet bidi te oyi mem. Di Jisas nandi wute men tebol te groq nindim ruso, di wute wapi mabri mawo mas wong mand kin ni mas kin komboiq te pombri nipim ruso.
Di wute aye God ningg baj imb pe yumbo rire ruso rindi kin te segi puq nindiny.

Di ni God ningg wand bei neny kin tende puayi ni pugri simbe nindiny nari, “God ningg wand rise kin buk pe God pugri puq nand, ‘Nge ningg baj te tiqe buagi nge ane wand ye baj puq munduw ye.’ Pudi nungoqi wute nyungu kin suqo mo ye sunyi kin pugri puq wew.” [Ais 56:7]

Muq prist mingg yumbui di wute Moses ningg lo wute bei meny ye ni ren kin mutungu di ni Jisas mi nati kin ngim meri mat. Te pugri wute buagi ni Jisas wand simbe nand kin te ningg puyene rind, pugri bu ni Jisas wune mimbig.
Di burpoq rip ningg tumo di Jisas nikin wute ane tiqe yumbui te si miraq mo.
Beghi yumbo ninge ningg God pengu bidig kin te pateri
Yambgriq ni mune nyinge mare mo di nyumo fig te tumuri pe grine quari namb pu yenu muqoind.
Pita ni te nuqoind di Jisas ni nyumo te ningg wand nand kin te mune nei nimbiny di ni Jisas ningg nari, “Tisa, te qond! Nyumo fig nu wand brequ gudig kin te yabe quari namb pre.”
Di Jisas oyi ni simbe nindim nari, “God ei nei wumbig.

Nge nungoqi nganyene simbe guduq, wuti iri rand nen ningg nari, ‘Nu yo gherim pe ir yaghe,’ di ninde umbo pe nari yumbo te ni nari kin pugrine puq ren ye ni nei tevi vise segi, tedi yumbo te ni nari kin pugrine puq ren ye.
Pugri bu nge nungoqi simbe guduq, nungoqi yumbo ninge ningg God pengu wundig te nungoqi nde umbo pe wari nungoqi yumbo te wateri ye puq wand, tedi nungoqi yumbo te wateri ye.

Di nungoqi God ane wand kin tende puayi wuti iri nu yumbo ur brequ nunduw kin te ghat rise pu rise wayequ. Nu ni mai te puaq ndig ei nu nuyi nginy tu wam nas kin ni oyi nu yumbo ur brequ guad kin mai te puaq nunduw.”
Jisas pengu mindig ni gre muai pu nateri
Muq ni mune mo Jerusalem mitari righe di Jisas ni God ningg baj imb wabe nyinge nare no no di prist mingg yumbui, wute Moses ningg lo wute bei meny ye di quayi kiyi ninge ni nde mondo.
Di ni Jisas pengu mindig mari, “Nu beghi simbe ndug, nu gre pughe ye pe yumbo ren yembe gudiny? Tughe nu ngiq nunduw bu nu yembe ren guad?”
Jisas oyi nand nari, “Muq nge oyi mune pengu ire nungoqi pengu guduq, di nungoqi nge simbe wundigh tedi nge oyi simbe guduq tughe nge ngiq nindigh bu nge yembe ren gad.
Nungoqi nge simbe wundigh, Jon ni tughe nde gre nateri di ni wute wuye nap? God nde pu nateri o wute nde pu nateri?”
Di ni kin kin wand mand mari, “Beghi pari God nde pu nateri, tedi ni beghi ningg nari, ‘Pughe kin ningg nungoqi Jon ningg wand te wutungu di nganyene puq wand segi’?”
Di wute buagi ni riri Jon ni nganyene propet iri, pugri bu ni mari, “Jon ni yembe te wute nde pu nateri,” puq mand wune mamb.
Te ningg di ni oyi mand kin mari, “Beghi nei bab segi.” Jisas nari, “Nge mune pugrine, nge tughe nde gre pe yumbo ren yembe gidiny kin te nungoqi simbe guduq segi.”
